tasks.title: Define target audience and expectations
tasks.desc: Define target age, game type preferences, and expected difficulty scale based on user profiles.

tasks.title: Write core game rules and objectives
tasks.desc: Detail controls, player objective rules, hazards constraints, and win/lose outlines.

tasks.title: Set up team Kanban task board
tasks.desc: Translate scope elements into task cards and assign initial owners on the board.

tasks.title: Define MVP scope features
tasks.desc: Isolate essential play loop items from later features. Must be small enough to build within sprints.

tasks.title: Program player controls and movement
tasks.desc: Implement keyboard Arrow and WASD keys movement with smooth coordinates updating.

tasks.title: Conduct peer testing review cycle
tasks.desc: Observe peers playing the current MVP build and note layout logic bottlenecks.

tasks.title: Design buttons, menus, and splash layouts
tasks.desc: Lay out visual button selectors, text banners, and visual headers.

tasks.title: Design scoring and health/timer parameters
tasks.desc: Establish how many score coordinates accrue for actions and health limits.

tasks.title: Define game win and lose conditions
tasks.desc: Program conditions: reaching end point prints win, losing health ends play.

tasks.title: Wire score update variables
tasks.desc: Program variables to increase when player intersects collectible sprites.

tasks.title: Illustrate level environment backdrop grids
tasks.desc: Create theme layouts, tile panels, and decorative backgrounds.

tasks.title: Draft playability check questionnaire
tasks.desc: Write checklist questions covering goal visibility, controls readability, and difficulty scores.

tasks.title: Design promotional website layout layouts
tasks.desc: Lay out catchy tagline text, screenshots, and visual branding logos.

tasks.title: Write step-by-step player manual instructions
tasks.desc: Draft clear keyboard mapping documentation and strategic hints.

tasks.title: Make a landing page for the game.
tasks.desc: Design a landing page that highlights the qualities of the game in simple dot points, as well as having a call to action so that people are encouraged to play the game
